report: 当前分析表明图像可能来自真实的相机传感器，但现有工具无法提供足够的证据来排除伪造的可能性。微噪声水平和JPEG结构分析都存在一定的不确定性，无法确定图像的真实来源。

evidence.phenomenon: Whole-image noise-residual level 3.6363: the camera end of the G2 calibration band. Residual consistent with a camera sensor; a band is an association measured on the calibration set, not a physical proof of origin.
evidence.reasoning: Whole-image residual micro-noise level 3.6363 (high). The G2 calibration set associates this band with camera capture: sensor noise that survives re-encoding. High residual does NOT indicate forgery — that is the original reading this expert was calibrated against — and sharpening inflates the metric with no sensor involved.
evidence.interpretation_text: Calibration: this measurement band corresponds to camera-source statistics (P(Fake)=0.28); the benign reading applies.
evidence.counter_explanation: 该指标衡量残差水平而非"不一致性"：G2 校准（格式配平，5 格）显示 Real 中位数 3.6 对 Fake 2.0，方向与原始"异常即伪造"的解释相反，且跨格式稳定（AUROC 0.15-0.23）。降噪、锐化与重压缩同样会改变该水平，故只应作为弱证据与校准似然配合使用。
evidence.applicability_conditions: 高 strength 统计上对应 Real（JPEG 压缩引入方差），不得按 AI-generated 解读；低 strength 侧（P(Fake)≈0.8）可作为弱证据使用。
evidence.interpretation_text_raw: High residual micro-noise level — spatially rich sensor noise of the kind the calibration set associates with camera capture.

evidence.phenomenon: JPEG structural analysis reveals DCT coefficient histogram hollowing. (blockiness: 1.5607, DCT anomaly: 3.5665)
evidence.reasoning: Moderate JPEG structure found (blockiness=1.5607, DCT anomaly=3.5665). This is the weaker end of the calibration band: the same structure appears when an already-compressed image is re-saved, and at low quality (≤ 70) the band loses its discriminative power almost entirely, so it should not drive a verdict on its own. Whether the band is decisive here depends on the cell the calibration table records for this input, which is attached to the token.
evidence.interpretation_text: Calibration: this measurement band is near chance (P(Fake)=0.45) and does not determine a direction.
evidence.counter_explanation: 本指标衡量"是否存在 JPEG 压缩历史"而非伪造痕迹：G2 校准显示高值倾向 Real（PNG 格分离度 0.972、native 0.962，但重压缩至 q70 后降至 0.569），即它主要反映来源的压缩历史。统一重压缩后的图像上该证据近乎无效，不得作为独立判据。
evidence.applicability_conditions: 高 strength 统计上对应 Real（原生 JPEG 照片）；q70 配平后分离度仅 0.57。仅当来源无压缩历史时可反向参考。
evidence.interpretation_text_raw: Intermediate JPEG structural level; this band is near the calibrated chance level, and re-compression weakens it further.
